comment: Naxxramas and the endgame Plaguelands (issue #24): the quests of Naxxramas and the quests of the two Plaguelands at the required level of 55 or more, with the quests they need. Chains only: no saga route holds them. Selection rules: tools/select_naxx.py.

chains.name: Naxxramas
chains.summary: 20 quests for Naxxramas at required level 60. The quests start with Archmage Angela Dosantos, Commander Eligor Dawnbringer, Korfax, Champion of the Light and 1 more.

chains.name: Plaguelands Endgame
chains.summary: 9 quests for Plaguelands Endgame at required levels 55 to 57. The quests start with Quartermaster Miranda Breechlock, Guard Didier, Haleh and 1 more.

chains.name: Plaguelands Endgame (Alliance)
chains.summary: 20 quests for Plaguelands Endgame at required levels 50 to 56. The quests start with Crier Goodman, Courier Hammerfall, Herald Moonstalker and 8 more.

chains.name: Plaguelands Endgame (Horde)
chains.summary: 9 quests for Plaguelands Endgame at required level 55. The quests start with High Executor Derrington, Apothecary Dithers, Argent Quartermaster Hasana and 2 more.
